name: Chen Shumei
current_role: Supervisor, Kunlun Investment (controlling holder of Guangzhou Xiangxue Pharmaceutical); former Xiangxue director (2010-2016)
profile: Chen Shumei (b. 1963) is listed by Hurun jointly with Xiangxue Pharmaceutical chairman Wang Yonghui. She sat on the board of Guangzhou Xiangxue Pharmaceutical (SZ:300147, modern TCM) from 2010 to 2016, after posts in Huangpu district foreign-trade bureau and as GM of Kunlun Technology; she is now a supervisor of Kunlun Investment.
interesting_fact: Before entering business she worked as an engineer at the Guangzhou Wanbao Group washing-machine factory, the same Wanbao group where Wang Yonghui was a technical-development head.
deep_cut_fact: Her official bio lists an early civil-service post as deputy section chief at the Guangzhou Huangpu District Foreign Economic & Trade Bureau before she ran Kunlun Technology.
notes: Low public profile; no personal channels found. Xiangxue is currently ST-flagged and in pre-restructuring per 2026 filings, so approach via the company board office may be slow. Hurun last listed her 2020.

name: Liang Jianhua
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Super Telecom Co., Ltd. (SH:603322; renamed 超讯科技 in June 2026)
profile: Liang Jianhua (b. 1969), a senior engineer, founded Guangzhou Super Telecom in 1998 to build, maintain and optimise telecom networks; it listed in Shanghai in 2016. He has chaired the board since 2011 and holds about 20% of the shares; the company was renamed Super Telecom Technology (超讯科技) in 2026.
interesting_fact: He is president of the Guangzhou Software Association and a Standing Committee member of the Tianhe District People's Congress.
deep_cut_fact: He started out in 1992 as an engineer at the Ministry of Posts & Telecommunications' Guangzhou Communications Equipment Factory, then spent 1995-98 at the Guangdong Posts & Telecom Technology Research Institute before founding Super Telecom.
notes: Board-office email is the published route. Relevant to podcast: telecom network infrastructure; check recent 2026 filings for new business lines after the rename.

name: Wu Jinxiang
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Luyan Pharma Co., Ltd. (SZ:002788), Xiamen
profile: Wu Jinxiang (b. 1962), an engineer by training, built Xiamen Luyan Pharmaceutical into Luyan Pharma, a Fujian-based distributor of drugs, TCM pieces, devices and vaccines with retail pharmacy chains, listed in Shenzhen in 2016. He remains chairman and GM and chairs its holding companies Xiamen Medicken and Xiamen Santai.
interesting_fact: Luyan is one of Fujian's leading pharmaceutical distribution groups, covering drugs, medical devices and vaccines plus a retail pharmacy chain.
deep_cut_fact: Before pharma distribution he worked at the Xiamen Capacitor Factory and at Xiamen Construction & Development Co.
notes: Board term listed to Oct 2026; check for re-election announcement. Route via securities department email.

name: Li Lianjie (Jet Li)
current_role: Martial-arts film star; founder of the One Foundation (Shenzhen One Foundation charity)
profile: Li Lianjie (Jet Li, b. 1963, Beijing), a five-time Chinese national wushu champion, became an international film star (Once Upon a Time in China, Hero, Fearless). Hurun listed him with wife Nina Li Chi for investments/entertainment. He founded the One Foundation in 2007, co-founded Taiji Zen with Jack Ma, and is a Singapore citizen.
interesting_fact: He founded the One Foundation in 2007 after nearly dying in the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami in the Maldives; in 2011 it became China's first private charitable fundraising foundation.
deep_cut_fact: His new book distils ten insights from his career and his 32-year Buddhist practice; at 11 he was a member of the 1974 Chinese national wushu team that toured the United States.
notes: Identity inferred from Hurun pairing with 'Li Zhi' (Nina Li Chi) and investments/entertainment; Hurun's 'Yuandong' label could not be matched to a company. Facebook/YouTube/TikTok also linked from jetli.world. Book tour suggests a publisher publicity route.

name: Joshua S Friedman
current_role: Co-Founder, Co-Chairman and Co-CEO, Canyon Partners, LLC (Dallas)
profile: Josh Friedman co-founded Canyon Partners (formerly Canyon Capital Advisors) with Mitchell Julis in 1990, after Drexel Burnham Lambert closed; the firm runs deep-value credit, structured credit and real-estate lending strategies (~$29bn AUM). He is a SEC filer at CBL & Associates as a member of Canyon's 10% owner group.
interesting_fact: Harvard physics summa graduate, Marshall Scholar at Oxford, Baker Scholar at HBS and magna cum laude at Harvard Law; he and Julis received Institutional Investor's Lifetime Achievement Award in 2014.
deep_cut_fact: He and Canyon co-founder Mitch Julis were roommates at Harvard; before Drexel (where he ran capital markets for high yield) he worked in Goldman Sachs' M&A department.
notes: Board roles include Harvard Management Co., Lincoln Center, LACMA, Dallas Museum of Art, Hoover Institution, Dallas Fed Financial Sector Advisory Council. CBL link confirmed via SEC ownership filings (member of 10% owner group). Investor-services email on Canyon site is for LPs only.

name: Liang Hongjian
current_role: Deputy GM of Gaoxin Sitong (chip subsidiary) and core technical staff, Shenzhen Consys Science & Technology (SH:688788); ~18% shareholder
profile: Liang Hongjian (b. 1972) helped build Shenzhen Consys from 2004, serving as deputy GM and director (2016-2022) of the maker of military electronic information equipment (command-and-control, radar signal processing). It listed on the STAR Market; he holds about 18% and now drives its chip subsidiary Gaoxin Sitong.
interesting_fact: He led R&D on Consys' command-information processing equipment, software-radar processing equipment and portable wireless command terminals, and now focuses on the company's in-house chip business.
deep_cut_fact: He began as an engineer in ZTE's switching division (1996-99), took a year out for further university study, then ran the OS department at Shenzhen Shengbo embedded-computer company before joining Consys in 2004.
notes: Defence-electronics company; may be reluctant to do media. Hurun 2021 'Consys' matched via Sina/annual report.

name: Jesse Caleb Wiley
current_role: Chair of the Board, John Wiley & Sons, Inc. (NYSE: WLY)
profile: Jesse C. Wiley (56) is a 7th-generation member of the Wiley publishing family. An employee since 2003 and director since 2012, he became board chair in 2019. He has worked in Wiley's research division on partnerships with academic and professional societies and in China, and in M&A, strategy, digital and new-business initiatives.
interesting_fact: He represents the seventh generation of the family behind Wiley, the research and education publisher founded in 1807.
deep_cut_fact: Before moving into strategy and business development he started at Wiley as a marketer and editor of professional books.

public_contacts.value: non-managementdirectors@wiley.com (board communications; mail also accepted to the Chair at 111 River St, Hoboken)

notes: Board-communication channel per FY26 proxy. wiley.com blocks automated fetches; check Wiley newsroom for press contact manually.

name: Yang Jianping
current_role: Director (founder and former chairman), Wuxi Xuelang Environmental Technology (SZ:300385)
profile: Yang Jianping (b. 1964) founded Wuxi Xuelang Conveyor Machinery in 2001, which became Xuelang Environmental, a maker of flue-gas cleaning and ash-handling systems for waste-to-energy plants, listed in 2014. He chaired it until Nov 2020 and remains a director; Hurun listed him with Xu Huifen.
interesting_fact: He sits on the expert committee of the China Association of Environmental Protection Industry's waste-incineration power technology innovation alliance, and was named a Jiangsu Provincial Model Worker.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Xuelang he worked at the Wuxi Changcheng Machinery Works, Wuxi Qianzhou General Machinery Factory and Xishan Xuelang Conveyor Machinery Factory.
notes: Waste-to-energy angle relevant to energy podcast. He has been selling down shares in 2025-26 per filings; company has been ST-flagged.

notes: Hurun China 2017 (To-win Capital, investments). Could not link 温晓东 to To-win Capital (同威资本's public filings name other principals); a CNINFO 温晓东 is an unrelated CAS chemist. Web-search budget ran out. No facts or contacts recorded.

name: Tan Zheng
current_role: Chairman and Executive Director, Immunotech Biopharm Ltd (HKEX: 6978); Chairman, BrainAurora Medical Technology (HKEX: 6681)
profile: Tan Zheng (48) is a pharma sales and commercialisation veteran who has led Immunotech Biopharm (Yongtai), a T-cell immunotherapy developer whose lead product EAL targets liver-cancer recurrence, since 2018, listing it in Hong Kong in 2020. He also chairs BrainAurora Medical Technology.
interesting_fact: Immunotech was the first T-cell immunotherapy specialist to list pre-revenue on HKEX (July 2020); its shares rose ~41% on debut.
deep_cut_fact: He began his career in 1998 at Shaanxi Buchang Pharmaceutical, rising to office supervisor of its Tianjin office, then ran Beijing offices for Shanxi Kanghui Pharmaceutical and Wuhan Heer Medical.
notes: Controls votes via Tan Zheng Ltd and a proxy arrangement. Company site not reachable from this environment; IR contact not found.

name: Zeng Zhijun
current_role: Non-executive director and co-actual controller, Richinfo Technology (SZ:300634); owner of Beijing Honghuaweiye Investment
profile: Zeng Zhijun (b. 1971), a PhD in management from Hong Kong PolyU, is co-controller with Yang Liangzhi of Richinfo, an industrial-internet tech and services firm (enterprise messaging, cloud). He holds ~20% via Shenzhen Bailong and other vehicles and wholly owns Beijing Honghuaweiye Investment (Hurun's 'Honghuaweiye').
interesting_fact: His career runs from IBM China systems engineer to Merrill Lynch investment banking to chairing Beijing Huaya Hexun before backing Richinfo.
deep_cut_fact: He started as an IBM China systems engineer and account manager (1993-96), then was a systems analyst and project manager at International Rectifier (1996-2000).
notes: Identity confirmed via Richinfo convertible-bond prospectus (2026). Low personal profile.

name: Zhang Jinshan
current_role: Chairman (and acting board secretary), Shanghai PhiChem Corporation (SZ:300398)
profile: Jinshan Zhang (b. 1963, US citizen) holds a chemistry PhD from the University of Michigan and founded Shanghai Phichem in 2002; it makes UV-curable coatings for optical fibre, display/LCD materials and semiconductor materials and listed in 2014. Hurun listed him with Wang Lili. He also chairs Jiangsu Hecheng Display Technology.
interesting_fact: Phichem's core UV-curing materials coat optical fibre, putting it in the supply chain for telecom and data-centre fibre networks.
deep_cut_fact: He earned a master's at the CAS Shanghai Institute of Optics and Fine Mechanics (1987) after a chemistry degree at East China Normal University (1983), before his 1993 Michigan PhD.
notes: Good fit for data-center angle (fibre coatings, semiconductor materials). US-educated; likely comfortable in English.

name: Su Zhi
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and core technical staff, Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics (SH:688020)
profile: Su Zhi (b. 1973), a chemical-process graduate of Dalian University of Technology with an SJTU master's in electrical engineering, spent a decade as a PCB engineer before founding Fangbang in 2010; it makes electromagnetic-shielding films and copper foils for flexible circuits and listed on the STAR Market in 2019. Hurun listed him with Li Dongmei.
interesting_fact: Fangbang was among the first batch of companies listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019.
deep_cut_fact: His first job (1997-98) was as an electroplating process engineer at the China Academy of Space Electronics Technology (中国空间电子技术研究所).
notes: Technical founder; electronics materials supply chain.

name: Bao Shijin
current_role: Founder and former chairman, Jiangsu SINOJIT Wind Energy Technology (SH:601218); no board seat listed after Dec 2023
profile: Bao Shijin (b. 1959), a senior economist, founded Jiangyin Jixin Machinery in 2003, which became Jiangsu Jixin Wind Energy (SINOJIT), a maker of large castings for wind turbines, listed in Shanghai. He chaired it from 2008 to April 2021 and then served as a director until late 2023.
interesting_fact: He was named an Excellent National Entrepreneur of the foundry industry (2010) and was a vice-chairman of the Jiangsu Renewable Energy Industry Association.
deep_cut_fact: He was a standing director of the China Foundry Association and in 2009 received the national 'Outstanding Entrepreneur of the Machinery Industry' award for 2007-08.
notes: Hurun labels industry 'solar equipment' but the company makes wind-turbine castings. Strong fit for energy podcast. Current status after leaving the board not confirmed.

name: Ke Zonggui
current_role: Co-founder and former vice chairman/president, Bluedon Information Security Technologies (formerly SZ:300297, now delisted); current role unknown
profile: Ke Zonggui (b. 1969), a Shenzhen University electronic-engineering graduate (1992), co-led Guangzhou-based cybersecurity firm Bluedon as vice chairman and president from 2009 to 2021. Bluedon has since been delisted.
interesting_fact: He authored the textbook 'Practical Computer Network Security Technology' and won a Ministry of Public Security science & technology award.
deep_cut_fact: He was a guest professor at Guangzhou City Construction College and earlier worked at Bank of China's Hong Kong computer software development centre in Shenzhen.
notes: Company delisted (蓝盾退); old board email no longer a reliable route. No current public channels found.

name: Lin Jingxiang
current_role: Shareholder (7.69%) and vice president, Jinghua Rizhao Steel Holding Group (parent of Rizhao Steel), as of 2017 filings
profile: Lin Jingxiang was a vice GM of Rizhao Steel Holding Group (2011-2012) and then of its parent Jinghua Rizhao Steel Holding Group, where he held a 7.69% stake alongside founder Du Shuanghua, per a 2017 legal opinion in Jinneng Technology's IPO filing. Rizhao Steel is one of China's largest private steelmakers.
interesting_fact: He is one of nine individual shareholders of the holding company that owns Rizhao Steel, the large private steelmaker in Shandong.
notes: Very private; information dates from 2017. Only company-level contact available.

name: Xiao Zhihong
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Tangel Culture Co., Ltd. (SZ:300148), Changsha; chairman of Hunan Jiachuang and Mingyuan Investment
profile: Xiao Zhihong (b. 1954) entered book distribution in 1983, set up Hunan Tianhong Investment in 2002 and in 2003 founded Hunan Tianzhou Science & Education Culture, now Tangel Culture, an educational publishing and culture company listed in 2010. He returned as chairman in 2024, re-elected in 2026.
interesting_fact: He founded Tangel in 2003 and returned as chairman in March 2024 after stepping back in 2020.
deep_cut_fact: He holds the professional title 'senior book distributor' (高级发行员), having started in book distribution in 1983, two decades before founding Tangel.
notes: Publishing veteran; route via board secretary email.

name: Charles A Davis
current_role: Chairman and Co-CEO, Stone Point Capital; Chair of the Board, BETA Technologies (since Feb 2021); director, Progressive Corp.
profile: Chuck Davis spent 23 years at Goldman Sachs (head of investment banking services worldwide, general partner) and was vice chairman of Marsh & McLennan before founding Stone Point Capital in 1998, a financial-services-focused investor with $65bn+ AUM. He chairs Vermont electric-aircraft maker BETA Technologies and has been a Progressive director since 1996.
interesting_fact: He chairs BETA Technologies, the Vermont electric aircraft and charging-network company, and was previously chairman of The Hershey Company's board.
deep_cut_fact: A University of Vermont graduate, he served on the board of Vermont's Merchants Bancshares from 1985 to 2008 and is credited as chief architect of Stone Point's 'Elephant Process' investment philosophy.
notes: Strong fit for energy/aviation electrification angle via BETA. Also on AXIS Capital and Fibrolamellar Cancer Foundation boards (Stone Point bio).
